business_meaning: Transaction Amount sign convention: Negative values represent outbound disbursements or credits to the customer (Refunds). Positive values denote inbound receipts or debits (Purchases, Fees).

downstream_systems.impact_note: Salesforce automation 'Process Refund' triggers strictly when Refund_Amount__c < 0. Positive values get flagged as invoice credits.
Maps negative amount directly to Posting Key 40 (Debit) or 50 (Credit) according to document type KR.
